purpose: Implement TsAnalyzer, the LanguageAnalyzer for TypeScript and JavaScript, per docs/spec/01-core-architecture.md Sections 14, 17 and 25 and docs/spec/03-multi-language-platform.md section 3. It parses one file with OXC and returns an owned FileAnalysis honouring the requested AnalysisProfile.
scope: crates/monokl/src/analysis/ts/{mod,parse}.rs behind the lang-ts feature, and the small-ts fixtures under crates/monokl/tests/fixtures/small-ts/. Dependencies keep their unresolved specifier (DependencyTarget::File with resolved: None).
non_goals: Import resolution (oxc_resolver), tsconfig handling and unresolved_aliases.
Methods, properties and other nested symbols; only top-level declarations are extracted.
The AnalyzerRegistry and any language other than TypeScript/JavaScript.
Reading the file or any I/O beyond calling the source closure.

api_surface.name: TsAnalyzer
api_surface.signature: pub struct TsAnalyzer; impl LanguageAnalyzer for TsAnalyzer
api_surface.description: Stateless analyzer for .ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx, .mts, .cts, .mjs and .cjs files; .d.ts files are not supported.
error_conditions: the source closure's error is returned unchanged

acceptance_criteria.criterion: supports is true for .ts .tsx .js .jsx .mts .cts .mjs .cjs paths and false for .d.ts, .rs and extensionless paths; language_for is Some(TypeScript) exactly when supports is true.

Analyzing each small-ts fixture file at Full yields exactly the symbols, exports, dependencies (specifier, bindings, line, resolved: None) and code blocks listed in the tests, with digest equal to Digest::blake3 of the source.

Dependencies fills only dependencies (and TsData::type_only_imports); Structural also fills symbols and exports; Full also fills blocks and TsData::jsx_elements. FileAnalysis::profile equals the requested profile.
Button.tsx yields a JSX element button (is_html) with attributes onClick and disabled, both expressions.
A file with a syntax error returns Ok with had_parse_errors true and still returns the declarations that parsed.
A file whose bracket nesting exceeds 2000 returns Ok with had_parse_errors true and empty symbols, dependencies, exports, blocks and JSX, without overflowing the stack.
A panic during parse or extraction is contained and reported as the same degraded result as AC-006.
The source closure's Err is returned unchanged and the closure is called exactly once.
Two analyses of the same source produce equal Debug output.
With --no-default-features the crate builds, lints and passes machete.

linked_research: docs/spec/01-core-architecture.md Sections 14, 17, 25; docs/spec/03-multi-language-platform.md section 3; docs/spec/05-research-and-decisions.md sections 17 and 20.
reasoning: Section 17's parse_full without resolution or caching, plus caliper's parse safety.
